attempts.raw_response: Tap on the Play Store icon, then search for "Unified Remote" in the search bar. Select the official app from the results and tap Install. Once installed, open the app and you'll see a welcome screen. Grant the necessary permissions when prompted, such as access to your local network. The app will automatically scan for your server; ensure both devices are on the same Wi-Fi network. Select your server from the list, and you're ready to control your desktop from your phone.
